propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of checkbox items, making them invisible to the AC item counter and ineligible for operator attestation tags.
A migration script must convert Success Criteria bullets to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes via rebar.edit_ticket, merging criteria into existing AC sections or creating them if absent.
The migration must preserve closed tickets' state by default while requiring explicit flags to touch open/in-progress tickets, to avoid silently invalidating in-flight plan-review attestations.
Order-agnostic merging and idempotent rewrites are required, with all affected tickets verified post-migration to return _count_ac_items >= 1 and carry no remaining Success Criteria headings.

Unit tests must cover five block-shape cases including SC-only, both-headings, mixed items, SC as final section, and no-op scenarios; dry-run evidence and skipped tickets must be recorded as ticket comments.
